ecological_prediction.conditional: If an independent structurally eligible 2021 wet-season panel exists and its 2021-specific vertical outcome has not already been used in the prior composite analysis, temporal-phase conditioning should attenuate centered vertical individuality more strongly than in the dry-season 2016/2022 panels.

decision.if_2021_admitted_but_original_pipeline_e: freeze exact 2021 structure and open a prospective year-specific test

claim_boundary: The wet-season mechanism prediction is generated after observing the 2023 temporal-phase result.
